new_articles.title: India’s passenger vehicle sales surge 33% in July, led by Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'India’s passenger vehicle sales surge 33% in July, led by Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai'이다.
